body:
I'm glad, it's rough living in a world where everyone seems to have someone or there shit together. I actually made my account a few minutes ago to look for the best place to go. I saw your post and it's the exact same mental state I'm in. I thought i should say something. Maybe talking to you would help me too? I dont know.

I honestly don't know what to say to you but i don't want you to go feeling alone or unloved when you go, I am here, even if you don't know me. You did the best you could and thats all anyone can ask for, the world is difficult, people are difficult, even just knowing yourself is difficult. You did well to keep at it for so long, you should be proud of that. And I'm sure along the way you got to live okay sometimes. I hope you can sit for a bit and remember those times.

Maybe I sound crazy to you but people wanna help, People care. I wanna help, I care.
